name: teamwork
description: Run a task with a Claude Code agent team. Build mode pairs a Sonnet driver with an Opus navigator under a Fable lead, with an optional UX specialist and senior consultant, an early draft PR, and parallel pairs for independent tasks. Review mode fans out lens-based reviewers over a PR with cross-verification. Ships the xp-navigator, xp-driver, xp-ux, xp-senior and xp-reviewer agent definitions.
